skill.name: docx
skill.description: Create, edit, inspect, redline, and validate Word DOCX files using OOXML-aware workflows and helper scripts.
skill.summary: Create, edit, redline, and validate DOCX files with OOXML-aware workflows.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Confirmed risks are limited to unvalidated ZIP extraction in Office archive unpacking and validation flows, plus sudo-based dependency installation guidance. Most static matches are false positives from OOXML namespaces, bundled schemas, markdown examples, local file operations, and validation identifiers. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious network behavior. Static review was capped at 400/452 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 52 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.
Replace every extractall call with a safe extraction helper that rejects absolute paths, parent-directory segments, and symlink escapes before writing files.
Do not instruct agents to run sudo automatically. Ask users to install system dependencies manually, or provide a container or preflight check.
Keep fixed argument lists, avoid shell=True, and require user confirmation before running pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, npm, or Python scripts on supplied documents.

content.value_statement: Word files are hard to inspect or edit safely at the OOXML level. This skill gives agents workflows, scripts, and examples for DOCX creation, redlining, comments, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Creates DOCX files with docx JavaScript examples.
Unpacks Office archives and formats XML for inspection.
Edits DOCX OOXML with a Python Document library.
Adds tracked changes, comments, replies, and related OOXML parts.
Packs and validates DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX archives with schema checks.
Converts DOCX files to PDF and page images when external tools are installed.
limitations: Requires local dependencies such as pandoc, docx, LibreOffice, Poppler, and defusedxml.
Complex documents still need manual XML inspection and final verification.
Archive extraction currently does not validate ZIP member paths before unpacking.
The schematic generator referenced in the guide is not included in this skill.

use_cases.title: Review Legal Documents
use_cases.description: Apply precise tracked changes, comments, and verification steps to contracts or policy documents.

use_cases.title: Build Structured Reports
use_cases.description: Create Word reports with headings, tables, images, page breaks, and consistent styles.

use_cases.title: Inspect OOXML Packages
use_cases.description: Validate relationships, content types, comments, and schema issues inside unpacked Office files.

prompt_templates.title: Extract DOCX Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the docx skill to convert my document at [path] to markdown, preserving tracked changes. Summarize the structure and comments.

prompt_templates.title: Create Word Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docx-js guidance to create a polished DOCX report from this outline. Include headings, tables, page breaks, and accessible image alt text.

prompt_templates.title: Edit With Redlines
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the redlining workflow to update [document path] with these changes: [list]. Apply precise insertions and deletions, then verify all changes.

prompt_templates.title: Repair OOXML Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the unpacked OOXML package at [directory]. Validate relationships, content types, comments, and schema issues. Explain each fix before repacking.

output_examples.input: Review a contract DOCX and change the notice period from 30 days to 60 days with reviewer comments.
output_examples.output: A revised DOCX with targeted tracked changes, reviewer comments, and verification notes for the changed phrases.

output_examples.input: Create a quarterly project report with sections, a status table, and image placeholders.
output_examples.output: A styled Word document with clear headings, a readable table, image placeholders, and accessibility notes.

output_examples.input: Validate an unpacked DOCX folder before repacking it.
output_examples.output: A concise validation report covering XML well-formedness, relationships, content types, comments, and tracked-change rules.

best_practices: Work on a copy of every document before unpacking, editing, or repacking it.
Use the redlining workflow for third-party, legal, academic, business, or government documents.
Convert the final document to markdown and verify expected phrases before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not unpack untrusted DOCX files into privileged or shared directories.
Do not use forced packing unless you understand every validation failure.
Do not edit another author's tracked changes directly; use nested tracked-change patterns.

faq.question: Can this skill create new Word documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes docx JavaScript guidance for creating DOCX files with text, tables, images, styles, and page breaks.

faq.question: Can it edit existing DOCX files?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides OOXML workflows and a Python Document library for editing unpacked Word documents.

faq.question: Does it support tracked changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes redlining workflows for precise insertions, deletions, comments, and verification.

faq.question: Does it require external tools?
faq.answer: Some workflows require tools such as pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, npm docx, or Python XML libraries.

faq.question: Can it validate repaired documents?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts check XML structure, relationships, content types, schemas, comments, and tracked-change rules.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted DOCX files?
faq.answer: Use caution. Current archive extraction uses ZIP extraction without member path validation, so unpack only in isolated work directories.
